clips.send: A frustrated dreamer sends this to a friend chasing a goal from lack, not need - the anxious truth about why wishing never pays off.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says most people get manifesting backwards: they wish, then they want - and wanting is the problem.

Wanting keeps the universe sending you more situations to want, never to have. Needing is different: it carries a sting, a real discomfort that forces you to define exactly what you're after.

Once you see yourself holding it, feel it as already yours, then let go of the outcome - that's when it moves. Kevin Trudeau calls it the windows of heaven opening.

What have you been quietly wanting instead of deciding you need?
